title: MegaMem: A Retrieval Solution for Ultra-Large Context Windows
abstract: arXiv:2608.22137v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Modern language models and agents increasingly require persistent memory for complete codebases, long interaction histories, and heterogeneous enterprise records. The key challenge is to keep hundreds of millions of tokens searchable while passing only bounded source evidence to the answer model. We introduce MegaMem, a source-resolved dual-view retrieval system that separates semantic access from generation evidence. Distilled records and detailed evidence are searched with original and transformed queries; every distilled hit resolves to an immutable source ID before reciprocal-rank fusion, deduplication, and cross-encoder reranking; and only the highest-ranked detailed evidence within a fixed budget supports generation. Post-answer attribution then identifies which loaded sources support the fixed answer. translated_title: MegaMem：面向超长上下文窗口的检索解决方案
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.22137v1 公告类型：新论文 摘要：现代语言模型和智能体越来越需要持久记忆来处理完整的代码库、长交互历史以及异构企业记录。关键挑战在于保持数亿个token的可搜索性，同时仅将有限的源证据传递给答案模型。我们引入了MegaMem，一种源解析的双视图检索系统，将语义访问与生成证据分离。蒸馏记录和详细证据通过原始查询和转换查询进行搜索；每个蒸馏命中在倒数排名融合、去重和交叉编码器重排序之前解析为不可变的源ID；仅在固定预算内排名最高的详细证据支持生成。回答后的归因功能识别哪些加载的源支持固定答案。我们在EnterpriseRAG-Bench上评估了MegaMem，该基准包含超过50万份异构企业文档和约600万条记录。
tldr: MegaMem通过双视图检索和源解析机制，在超长上下文中高效搜索数亿token，并仅传递有限证据以支持生成和归因。
en_tdlr: MegaMem efficiently searches hundreds of millions of tokens in ultra-long contexts via dual-view retrieval and source resolution, passing only bounded evidence for generation and attribution.
